name: Butterfly Ray Marching with SDFs
definition: Rendering a swarm of butterflies using Signed Distance Functions (SDFs) for the body, antenna, and wings, combined with ray marching in a transformed local coordinate space to handle wing flapping and orientation.
summary: Butterfly Ray Marching with SDFs renders animated butterfly swarms by combining anatomical SDFs with a non-rigid un-bend transform and stability clamping for dynamic wing flapping.
